description: WEA CLI library modules — importable Python modules, not directly executable scripts.

required.name: module_docstring
required.description: Module-level docstring as the first statement in the file

required.name: future_annotations
required.description: from __future__ import annotations at the top of imports

optional.name: class_definitions
optional.description: Class definitions for data types, commands, or structured outputs

optional.name: function_definitions
optional.description: Public functions that implement CLI subcommands or reusable logic

excluded.name: main_guard
excluded.description: Library modules must not contain if __name__ == '__main__' — use scripts/ zone for runnable entry points
